newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas little changed in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas little changed in slow trade.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were on either side of unchanged Monday as continuing warm weather in Alberta supported domestic pricing, sources said.
Spot gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub moved up a couple of cents to C$1.46-1.48 per gigajoule, while August AECO also popped up about one to two cents to C$1.45.
August-October AECO pricing was quoted at C$1.435-1.45, while one-year business was talked at C$1.65-1.67.
According to Weather Services Corp, temperatures in Calgary were expected to hover near 80 degrees F Tuesday and then climb to a high of 83 degrees F Wednesday.
At Sumas, Wash., prices slipped about two cents to about $1.06 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) in light trade.
In the East, prices at Niagara also eased by about two cents to $2.29-2.30 in response to the softer opening on NYMEX and cooler weather in the area, traders said.
